newsitem.title: USA: ACT Networks agrees to acquire SourceCom.
newsitem.headline: ACT Networks agrees to acquire SourceCom.

text.p: ACT Networks Inc said on Friday that it had agreed to acquire all the assets of SourceCom Inc as part of a development plan that would negatively impact the company's financial results this year.

"If this transaction is completed, ACT intends to expend significant resources in developing products and the marketplace, which would negatively impact the company's financial results for the current fiscal year," ACT said in a statement.
SourceCom, a technology company specializing in the development of high density xDSL systems, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on July 16.
ACT did not disclose terms of the acquisition agreement, but said the deal was subject to bankruptcy court approval.

ACT added that it believes SourceCom's technology can be adapted to serve its own customers. SourceCom supplies digital subscriber line technology that permits high-speed Internet access to run over standard phone lines.
ACT Networks Inc manufactures Frame Relay wide-area network access products which support voice, data and network applications.
